Abstract.AbstractText: Highly efficient asymmetric Diels-Alder reactions of methyleneindolinones with 1,3-dienylcarbamates and 1,2-dihydropyridines have been accomplished by using a chiral N,N'-dioxide/nickel(ii) complex as an efficient catalyst. New kinds of spirooxindole-cyclohexaneamides were achieved in up to 99% yield, >95 : 5 dr, and 99% ee.
